CAMPAIGN_PROCESS_BOUNDARY: parent plus all preflight/concurrent/restart/crash helpers and any descendant; session membership and remaining-process audit must be independently verified
CLEANUP_EVIDENCE: no deletion/reset consumption; audit termination or unknown outcome; no retry
EXIT_OBSERVATION: independent creation ID/PID+lifetime token/session or cgroup; wait/reap statuses; signal classification; enumerate remaining members; any ambiguity UNKNOWN
FAILURE_POLICY: partial/escaped/unknown/observer failure is failure or uncertainty, never completion
PROCESS_TREE_TERMINATION: independently qualified race-free boundary; process-group-only solution rejected due helper new sessions
TERMINATION_TRIGGER: absolute deadline or first unhandled parent/observer failure; no voluntary bootstrap dependency
TIMEOUT_EVIDENCE: deadline/start/trigger/signal/reap/remaining-members with first failure and secondary failures, consumed/unknown authorization unavailable
TIME_SOURCE: independent monotonic clock from before included setup/launch through completion/stop/publication; exact clock/error bounds unqualified
UNSEALED: bounded failure-evidence schema and deadline publication policy
WATCHDOG_OWNER: independent qualification resource/exit observer; exact identity unsealed
